slides.title: Sound in *colour*
replace: SUBJECT: a young person beaming with pure joy, head tilted back, face dotted with glossy smiley and daisy stickers.
COMPOSITION: the face fills the upper two-thirds against open blue sky; the lower third stays quieter sky for the type.
COLOUR: candy pink and mint accents over warm skin and bright blue sky.

slides.title: Pure *good days*
replace: SUBJECT: two friends cheek to cheek mid-laugh, sunglasses pushed up, faces covered in flower and star stickers, sharing one pair of earbuds.
COMPOSITION: the pair sits high and to the right against the sky; the lower-left stays open sky for the headline.
COLOUR: lilac and yellow accents over vivid blue sky.

slides.title: Scored like a *show*.
replace: SUBJECT: a single hand thrown up toward the sky, wrist stacked with beaded bracelets, a smiley sticker on the thumb.
COMPOSITION: the hand reaches in from the bottom edge; most of the frame is open blue sky with lots of calm space up top.
COLOUR: baby blue and pink, mostly sky.
